recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-17185; future changes to logical-model terminology or the deprecated keyword element should be handled under newer focused trackers.
issue_request: FHIR-17185 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked to clarify or replace confusing logical-model terminology. The final resolution retained logical as a StructureDefinition kind while requiring clearer complex/resource definitions, an extensible keyword binding to observed uses, improved keyword wording, removal of sdf-7, and narrowed constraints for non-HL7-originated StructureDefinitions.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git commit 926384dea351e7ec4743590f452b9873a9e3c5be, svn revision 13873, which created definition-use terminology, updated the keyword binding and wording, removed sdf-7, and changed the relevant custom-type/default-value constraints. Later source refactors, especially 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157, moved the applied content into current XML source.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists structuredefinition=StructureDefinition. Current StructureDefinition.kind retains logical and the kind terminology distinguishes complex types, resources that aggregate other types, and logical patterns/templates. FHIR-33100 later deprecated StructureDefinition.keyword in favor of artifact-topic, but did not require undoing the FHIR-17185 binding audit. Related logical-model constraint audits for FHIR-19762, FHIR-21622, and FHIR-33065 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current source already has no sdf-7, scopes sdf-19 to HL7 StructureDefinition URLs, splits default-value constraints appropriately, keeps StructureDefinition.keyword bound extensibly to ValueSet/definition-use with use/content wording, and carries clarified StructureDefinitionKind terminology.

related_jiras.note: Originally added StructureDefinition.kind=logical; FHIR-17185 clarified and retained that kind rather than removing it.
